thread:
samir.k: quick question — we got a DSR from acme-corp asking for deletion of all request logs and any cached artifacts tied to customer_id=acme-42. Are request logs covered by the standard 90d retention or do we need a retention-exception flow? also: do our kv-caches (redis) store any customer-identifying tokens that we should flush?

eva.s: request logs are 90d by default, PII is redacted at ingest if matched by the scrubbing rules. if the DSR is for full deletion (right to be forgotten) we need a ticket in the data-deletion queue + approval from security/legal.

olivia.p: regarding caches — the short answer: our edge-redis instances keep only opaque session keys, but the request-metadata cache (service: request-memo) stores a JSON blob with customer_id for 7d TTL. we don't automatically sweep on DSRs. can do targeted flush per-customer.

samir.k: ok thanks. what's the safe /authorized way to do a targeted flush? don't want to run a global delete by accident.

olivia.p: runbook excerpt: ```
# targeted cache purge
POST https://infra-api.internal/v1/cache/purge
body: { \"service\": \"request-memo\", \"filter\": { \"customer_id\": \"acme-42\" } }
# returns job_id, then monitor /jobs/:id
```
only infra or security can trigger; we need a ticket and an approver.

leah: for DSRs, open a ticket in the data-deletion queue (TKT-DC-XXXX). include customer_id, scope (logs/caches/traces), legal request copy, and desired deadline. add the security reviewer tag. I'll triage within 24h.

samir.k: copying legal here — @eva.s can you confirm approval path? also, can we mark this high-priority for a 48h completion? customer says a regulator deadline.

eva.s: yup — if legal confirms it meets scope, security does expedited approval. need the ticket + legal note. note: request logs older than 90d might already be in S3 lifecycle; if they're within 90d we need to run the delete job. for S3 objects we'll run a delete-with-ttl override and log the action.

jonathan-oncall: infra ready to run the purge once we have TKT-DC-2039 (placeholder) and security approve. command we run (internal): ```
./bin/purge-logs --customer acme-42 --services request-logs,request-memo --dry-run=false
# prints job uuid
```

security-bot: Policy note: retention policy v2.1 requires a documented ticket for deletions, approval from sec/legal, and an audit entry. Links: https://confluence.internal/policies/data-retention and https://runbooks.internal/cache-purge

samir.k: created ticket TKT-DC-2039 and added legal attestation. tagging @leah @olivia.p for follow-up. will update here when infra gives job id. :eyes:

leah: acknowledged. tagging security for expedited review. :white_check_mark:

olivia.p: once job id is back, i'll verify cache entries are gone and close the ticket. if any traces contain customer_id we may need to redact instead (traces are tricky).

samir.k: thanks all — will post job id/confirmation in this thread after infra runs it.
